Package dayplanner

Class RasParser

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.RasParser
public final class RasParser extends Object

Parses and writes RAS (Readable Activity Serial) activity records.

RAS records are comma-delimited and wrapped in angle brackets. Commas in field values are not escaped.

For more information, read the README.md documentation.

    • parse

      public static Activity parse(String ras)

      Parses one RAS record and creates its corresponding activity.

      Unknown type names produce a plain Activity, preserving the format's existing fallback behavior.

      Parameters:
      ras - Serialized activity record.
      Returns:
      The activity represented by the record.

      public static String[] fields(String ras)
      Returns the fields inside one RAS record. Missing fields are retained as empty strings so the activity class can apply its existing defaults.
      Parameters:
      ras - Serialized activity record.
      Returns:
      The record fields, including the activity type at index zero.
